verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud platform, but the evidence pack documents no way to run AWS itself on your own infrastructure. The nearest items are adjacent only. DynamoDB Local is a single-service development and test emulator, not a self-hosted deployment. The open-source CDK and MCP servers are client-side tooling, not the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
